comment: Third-party assertion files as regression inputs (README.md here). Each unit is parsed as one compilation unit (sva parse, in order) and must give exactly 'assertions' with no error; its description is golden/third_party/<name>.txt. 'eval': sva eval over the dump of an example (make examples: $(BUILD)/examples/<example>/<example>.fst) at 'scope'; every assertion is evaluated and none fails except the ones in 'fail' (name: [pass, fail]). make smoke runs the evaluations.
